name: Android emulator
description: An Android card in the workspace: watch and control an Android emulator (or a phone connected to the server computer) live. Widen the card for an Android Studio–style layout with Logcat, apps, device files, simulated controls, snapshots, a layout inspector and screen recording. Claude, dimensio and Antigravity can use the same device to install apps, tap, take screenshots and read logs. Host only; needs the Android SDK and emulator on the server computer.

sdkPath.label: Android SDK location
sdkPath.desc: Leave empty to look in ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, then %LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk.

idleMinutes.label: Turn off idle emulators after (minutes)
idleMinutes.desc: 0 = never. A snapshot is saved on shutdown, so it starts again in seconds.

tools.label: Give agents the Android tool
tools.desc: When off, the card still works, but Claude, dimensio and Antigravity no longer get the android tool.
